newsitem.title: UK: BFI up one, Panamaxes firmer in South Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: BFI up one, Panamaxes firmer in South Atlantic.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up one on Monday to 1,281 points.
Brokers said that although Caper and Handy-size markets remained quiet a high volume of firmer fixtures were reported from Argentina and Brazil.
Northern Venture 68,519 dwt was rumoured fixed to Andre delivery Passero trip via East Coast South America redelivery Far East at $12,750.

Brokers reported Continental fixed three Panamaxes in the same trades, Nemea 68,800 dwt delivery East Coast South America mid-July $12,250 daily plus $230,000 bonus, Blessing 69,997 dwt delivery Santos at about $12,300 daily plus $250,000 bonus, Torm Gerd 69,451 dwt delivery Morocco at close to $12,500 daily.
The Baltic Handy Index was down three to 1,013.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 10 points higher and turnover was 25 lots.
